narrative.northStar: Veterinary Audiology & Neko Ban Ban Field Console
narrative.overview: CattySafe is an operational bio-acoustic instrument built for drivers standing beside a parked vehicle in a carport, street, or dim underground garage. Its visual system draws from Japanese Neko Ban Ban automotive inspection protocols and veterinary audiology field instruments.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-Environment Day/Night Garage Polarity (#EDF1F5 daylight slate-mist / #11151A night asphalt)
Tri-Role Semantic Action Coding (Vermilion for Deter, Cobalt for Coax, Emerald for Cleared)
Live Bio-Acoustic Telemetry over the 45 Hz – 64 kHz feline hearing curve
Drawn 1.85px-stroke technical SVG iconography and schematic geometry

rules.name: The Functional Signal Rule
rules.body: Vermilion (#C23B13), Cobalt (#1554C0), and Emerald (#0D6B49) never appear as decorative splashes; they strictly encode Deter/Flush, Coax/Lure, and Cleared Zone states respectively.

rules.name: The 3:1 Boundary Rule
rules.body: Every interactive button, sound card, switch, and zone stub carries an explicit 1px border (#5B6B82 light / #6C7787 dark) with at least 3:1 contrast against its surface.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: All live Hz readouts, countdown timers, and frequency band badges must use JetBrains Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so rapidly sweeping frequencies never jitter layout width.

rules.name: The Neutral Shadow Rule
rules.body: Elevation shadows are always neutral slate/black with soft blur; never use chromatic glow shadows on dark or light surfaces.

dos: Do pair high-frequency sweeps (13.5–19.5 kHz) with the live Feline vs. Human Audiogram canvas so drivers see the active frequency relative to feline pinnae sensitivity.
Do keep Coax/Lure profiles (#1554C0 Cobalt) visually distinct from Deter/Flush profiles (#C23B13 Vermilion) to prevent drivers from panicking kittens trapped inside engine bays.
Do keep button labels (ปล่อยคลื่นเสียง, หยุดเสียง, รอตรวจเช็ค) on a single line with white-space: nowrap.
donts: Don't add eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
Don't use Unicode emojis in place of drawn 1.85px-stroke SVG icons.
Don't use warm cream/beige page backgrounds or colored neon box-shadow glows.
